mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id as loginId, password_hash as passwordHash, name, is_active as isActive FROM platform_admin WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND is_active = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_admin (login_id, password_hash, name, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, true, NOW(), NOW())
